Pareto kecacatan dan analisis kehilangan yield
Drill-down punca akar untuk langkah proses abnormal
Kontrak data kualiti pembuatan dan pengesahan UAT

document_info.requirement_name: Keperluan contoh: ABF manufacturing yield loss analysis

background.summary: Ini ialah contoh perniagaan terbina dalam untuk memulakan templat berisi dengan pantas. ABF yield data is split across MES, QMS, inspection, and equipment systems. Quality and process teams need a unified view to identify yield loss by lot, panel, product, process step, equipment, and defect reason.
background.objective: Jana dokumen PRD dan reka bentuk berdasarkan contoh; perubahan pengguna kemudian mengatasi contoh.

in_scope: Lot, panel, product, and process-step analysis
Abnormal yield alerts and closure tracking

core_scenarios: Engineer reviews yield trend by product and process step.
User drills into a low-yield lot and checks defect Pareto.
Process owner creates an abnormal closure action.
